level: # 瞬間英作文（TOEIC Bridge 対策）。alternatives は | 区切りの別解。

japanese: 私は毎朝電車で通勤します。
english: I go to work by train every morning.
alternatives: I commute by train every morning.|I take the train to work every morning.
explanation: 習慣は現在形。「〜で」の交通手段は by + 乗り物（冠詞なし）。

japanese: その店は午前10時に開きます。
english: The store opens at 10 a.m.
alternatives: The shop opens at 10 a.m.|The store opens at ten a.m.|The store opens at 10.
explanation: 営業時間など決まっている事実は現在形。主語が三人称単数なので opens。

japanese: 彼女は営業部で働いています。
english: She works in the sales department.
alternatives: She works in sales.|She works in the sales section.
explanation: 職場を表す「〜で働く」は work in / at / for。

japanese: 会議室は2階にあります。
english: The meeting room is on the second floor.
alternatives: The conference room is on the second floor.
explanation: 「〜階に」は on the 序数 floor。

japanese: このバスは空港に行きますか？
english: Does this bus go to the airport?
alternatives: Is this bus going to the airport?
explanation: 行き先の確認は Does + 乗り物 + go to 〜? が定番。

japanese: 私はふだん7時に起きます。
english: I usually get up at seven.
alternatives: I usually wake up at seven.|I usually get up at 7.
explanation: 頻度の副詞 usually は一般動詞の前に置く。

japanese: 駅はここから遠くありません。
english: The station is not far from here.
alternatives: The station isn't far from here.
explanation: 「〜から遠い」は far from 〜。

japanese: あなたの電話番号は何番ですか？
english: What is your phone number?
alternatives: What's your phone number?|What is your telephone number?
explanation: TOEIC Bridge の会話問題でよく出る質問。

japanese: 私は昨日その書類を送りました。
english: I sent the document yesterday.
alternatives: I sent the documents yesterday.
explanation: send の過去形は sent。yesterday は文末が自然。

japanese: 電車は10分遅れました。
english: The train was ten minutes late.
alternatives: The train was 10 minutes late.|The train was delayed for ten minutes.|The train was delayed by ten minutes.
explanation: 「〜分遅れる」は be + 時間 + late。delay を使うなら受け身。

japanese: 私たちは先週末にその博物館を訪れました。
english: We visited the museum last weekend.
alternatives: We went to the museum last weekend.
explanation: last weekend など過去の時を表す語には前置詞をつけない。

japanese: 彼は会議に来ませんでした。
english: He didn't come to the meeting.
alternatives: He did not come to the meeting.
explanation: 過去の否定は didn't + 動詞の原形。

japanese: 昨日はとても忙しかったです。
english: I was very busy yesterday.
alternatives: I was really busy yesterday.
explanation: be動詞の過去形 was / were。

japanese: 昨夜はどこで夕食を食べましたか？
english: Where did you have dinner last night?
alternatives: Where did you eat dinner last night?
explanation: 過去の疑問文は did + 主語 + 原形。

japanese: 私は駅でかさをなくしました。
english: I lost my umbrella at the station.
alternatives: I left my umbrella at the station.
explanation: lose の過去形は lost。「置き忘れる」なら leave → left。

japanese: その映画は何時に始まりましたか？
english: What time did the movie start?
alternatives: When did the movie start?|What time did the movie begin?
explanation: What time + did + 主語 + 原形?

japanese: 明日あなたに電話します。
english: I'll call you tomorrow.
alternatives: I will call you tomorrow.
explanation: その場で決めた意志は will。I'll は I will の短縮形。

japanese: 来月東京へ出張する予定です。
english: I'm going to go to Tokyo on business next month.
alternatives: I am going to go to Tokyo on business next month.|I'm going to Tokyo on business next month.|I'm going on a business trip to Tokyo next month.
explanation: 前から決めている予定は be going to。on business =「仕事で」。

japanese: 今夜は雨が降るでしょう。
english: It will rain tonight.
alternatives: It's going to rain tonight.|It is going to rain tonight.
explanation: 天気は It を主語にする。

japanese: 会議は3時に始まります。
english: The meeting will start at three.
alternatives: The meeting starts at three.|The meeting will begin at three.|The meeting will start at 3.
explanation: 予定された行事は現在形でも表せる。

japanese: 週末は何をするつもりですか？
english: What are you going to do this weekend?
alternatives: What will you do this weekend?|What are you doing this weekend?
explanation: 週末の予定を尋ねる定番表現。

japanese: 私が窓を開けましょう。
english: I'll open the window.
alternatives: I will open the window.
explanation: 申し出の I'll 〜。Shall I open the window? も可。

japanese: 彼は来週戻ってきます。
english: He will be back next week.
alternatives: He'll be back next week.|He will come back next week.
explanation: be back =「戻ってくる」。電話応対でもよく使う。

japanese: バスはまもなく到着します。
english: The bus will arrive soon.
alternatives: The bus will be here soon.|The bus is arriving soon.
explanation: soon =「まもなく」。アナウンスの定番。

japanese: 今、昼食を食べているところです。
english: I'm having lunch now.
alternatives: I am having lunch now.|I'm eating lunch now.|I am eating lunch now.
explanation: 今まさにしていることは現在進行形 be + 動詞ing。

japanese: 彼は電話中です。
english: He is on the phone.
alternatives: He's on the phone.|He is talking on the phone.
explanation: on the phone =「電話中で」。

japanese: 何をしているのですか？
english: What are you doing?
explanation: 現在進行形の疑問文。

japanese: 私が電話したとき彼女は料理をしていました。
english: She was cooking when I called.
alternatives: She was cooking when I called her.|When I called she was cooking.
explanation: 過去進行形 was / were + 動詞ing。

japanese: 私たちは新しい事務所を探しています。
english: We are looking for a new office.
alternatives: We're looking for a new office.
explanation: look for =「〜を探す」。

japanese: 男性が箱を運んでいます。
english: A man is carrying a box.
alternatives: The man is carrying a box.
explanation: 写真描写問題で頻出の形。

japanese: 女性たちがテーブルを囲んで座っています。
english: The women are sitting around a table.
alternatives: Women are sitting around a table.|The women are sitting around the table.
explanation: around 〜 =「〜の周りに」。写真描写の定番。

japanese: 雨が降り始めています。
english: It's starting to rain.
alternatives: It is starting to rain.|It's beginning to rain.|It is beginning to rain.
explanation: start to 〜 / start 〜ing どちらも可。

japanese: 窓を開けてもいいですか？
english: May I open the window?
alternatives: Can I open the window?
explanation: 許可を求める May I 〜? は Can I 〜? より丁寧。

japanese: 手伝ってもらえますか？
english: Can you help me?
alternatives: Could you help me?|Will you help me?
explanation: 依頼の Can you 〜?。Could you 〜? はより丁寧。

japanese: ここで写真を撮ってはいけません。
english: You must not take pictures here.
alternatives: You can't take pictures here.|You cannot take pictures here.|You must not take photos here.|You mustn't take pictures here.
explanation: must not =「〜してはいけない」（禁止）。

japanese: 明日早く来なければなりません。
english: I have to come early tomorrow.
alternatives: I must come early tomorrow.|I need to come early tomorrow.
explanation: have to =「〜しなければならない」。

japanese: 急ぐ必要はありません。
english: You don't have to hurry.
alternatives: You do not have to hurry.|You don't need to hurry.|There's no need to hurry.
explanation: don't have to =「〜する必要はない」。must not との違いに注意。

japanese: いっしょに昼食を食べませんか？
english: Shall we have lunch together?
alternatives: Why don't we have lunch together?|Let's have lunch together.|Would you like to have lunch together?
explanation: Shall we 〜? / Why don't we 〜? =「〜しませんか」。

japanese: もう少しゆっくり話していただけますか？
english: Could you speak more slowly?
alternatives: Could you speak a little more slowly?|Can you speak more slowly?
explanation: Could you 〜? は丁寧な依頼。

japanese: コーヒーをいかがですか？
english: Would you like some coffee?
alternatives: Would you like a cup of coffee?|Do you want some coffee?
explanation: Would you like 〜? =「〜はいかがですか」。勧めるときは some。

japanese: 傘を持って行ったほうがいいですよ。
english: You should take an umbrella.
alternatives: You should bring an umbrella.|You'd better take an umbrella.
explanation: should =「〜したほうがいい」。

japanese: 彼は英語を話すことができます。
english: He can speak English.
alternatives: He is able to speak English.
explanation: can + 動詞の原形。

japanese: このかばんはあれより軽いです。
english: This bag is lighter than that one.
alternatives: This bag is lighter than that.
explanation: 比較級 -er + than。one は bag の繰り返しを避ける代名詞。

japanese: これは店でいちばん人気のある商品です。
english: This is the most popular item in the store.
alternatives: This is the most popular product in the store.|This is the most popular item in the shop.
explanation: 長い形容詞の最上級は the most 〜。

japanese: バスは電車より安いです。
english: The bus is cheaper than the train.
alternatives: Taking the bus is cheaper than taking the train.
explanation: cheap → cheaper。

japanese: 今日は昨日ほど寒くありません。
english: It's not as cold today as yesterday.
alternatives: It is not as cold today as yesterday.|It isn't as cold today as it was yesterday.|Today is not as cold as yesterday.|It's not as cold today as it was yesterday.
explanation: not as 〜 as … =「…ほど〜ない」。

japanese: もっと大きいサイズはありますか？
english: Do you have a larger size?
alternatives: Do you have a bigger size?|Do you have this in a larger size?|Do you have this in a bigger size?
explanation: 店での定番表現。large → larger。

japanese: 彼はチームでいちばん背が高いです。
english: He is the tallest in the team.
alternatives: He's the tallest on the team.|He is the tallest on the team.|He's the tallest in the team.
explanation: 最上級 the -est。in / on the team。

japanese: 私はコーヒーより紅茶のほうが好きです。
english: I like tea better than coffee.
alternatives: I prefer tea to coffee.|I like tea more than coffee.
explanation: like A better than B =「BよりAが好き」。

japanese: できるだけ早く返事をください。
english: Please reply as soon as possible.
alternatives: Please answer as soon as possible.|Please reply as soon as you can.
explanation: as 〜 as possible =「できるだけ〜」。ビジネスメールの定番。

japanese: 私は海外で働きたいです。
english: I want to work abroad.
alternatives: I'd like to work abroad.|I would like to work abroad.
explanation: want to 〜 =「〜したい」。abroad は副詞なので to は不要。

japanese: 切符を買うために駅へ行きました。
english: I went to the station to buy a ticket.
alternatives: I went to the station to buy tickets.
explanation: 目的を表す to 不定詞「〜するために」。

japanese: 英語を話すのは楽しいです。
english: Speaking English is fun.
alternatives: It's fun to speak English.|It is fun to speak English.
explanation: 動名詞の主語。It is 〜 to … の形も可。

japanese: 雨がやみました。
english: It stopped raining.
alternatives: The rain stopped.|It has stopped raining.
explanation: stop 〜ing =「〜するのをやめる」。

japanese: 私は読書が好きです。
english: I like reading.
alternatives: I like to read.|I like reading books.
explanation: like 〜ing / like to 〜 どちらも可。

japanese: 何か飲み物がほしいです。
english: I want something to drink.
alternatives: I'd like something to drink.|I would like something to drink.
explanation: something to drink =「何か飲むもの」（形容詞的用法）。

japanese: 報告書を書き終えました。
english: I finished writing the report.
alternatives: I've finished writing the report.|I have finished writing the report.
explanation: finish の後ろは動名詞。finish to 〜 は誤り。

japanese: 彼はその知らせを聞いて驚きました。
english: He was surprised to hear the news.
explanation: 感情の原因を表す to 不定詞。

japanese: どこで乗り換えればいいか教えてください。
english: Please tell me where to change trains.
alternatives: Please tell me where to transfer.|Could you tell me where to change trains?
explanation: 疑問詞 + to 〜 =「どこで〜すべきか」。

japanese: この製品は日本で作られています。
english: This product is made in Japan.
explanation: 受動態 be + 過去分詞。made in + 国。

japanese: その店は月曜日は閉まっています。
english: The store is closed on Mondays.
alternatives: The shop is closed on Mondays.|The store is closed on Monday.
explanation: closed は形容詞的に使われる。曜日の複数形で「毎週〜曜日」。

japanese: 会議は延期されました。
english: The meeting was postponed.
alternatives: The meeting was put off.
explanation: postpone =「延期する」の受動態。アナウンスで頻出。

japanese: 朝食は7時から出されます。
english: Breakfast is served from seven.
alternatives: Breakfast is served from 7.|Breakfast is served from seven o'clock.
explanation: serve =「（食事を）出す」。ホテルの案内で頻出。

japanese: このビルでは喫煙は禁止されています。
english: Smoking is not allowed in this building.
alternatives: Smoking is prohibited in this building.|Smoking isn't allowed in this building.
explanation: be not allowed =「許されていない」。

japanese: 私はパーティーに招待されました。
english: I was invited to the party.
explanation: invite 人 to 〜 の受動態。

japanese: その歌は世界中で愛されています。
english: The song is loved all over the world.
alternatives: The song is loved around the world.
explanation: all over the world =「世界中で」。

japanese: その会社は1990年に設立されました。
english: The company was founded in 1990.
alternatives: The company was established in 1990.
explanation: found（設立する）と find（見つける）の違いに注意。

japanese: 私はもう昼食を食べました。
english: I have already had lunch.
alternatives: I've already had lunch.|I have already eaten lunch.|I've already eaten lunch.
explanation: 完了の現在完了 have + 過去分詞。already は have の後。

japanese: 京都に行ったことがありますか？
english: Have you ever been to Kyoto?
explanation: 経験は Have you ever been to 〜?。

japanese: 私はここに5年間住んでいます。
english: I have lived here for five years.
alternatives: I've lived here for five years.|I have lived here for 5 years.|I've been living here for five years.
explanation: 継続の現在完了。for + 期間。

japanese: 荷物はまだ届いていません。
english: The package hasn't arrived yet.
alternatives: The package has not arrived yet.|The package hasn't come yet.
explanation: 否定文の yet =「まだ」。

japanese: 私はかぎをなくしてしまいました。
english: I've lost my key.
alternatives: I have lost my key.|I've lost my keys.
explanation: 結果の現在完了（今も見つかっていない）。

japanese: 彼女は先週からずっと病気です。
english: She has been sick since last week.
alternatives: She's been sick since last week.|She has been ill since last week.
explanation: since + 起点 =「〜以来ずっと」。

japanese: その映画を3回見たことがあります。
english: I have seen the movie three times.
alternatives: I've seen the movie three times.|I have seen that movie three times.|I've seen that movie three times.
explanation: 回数は 〜 times。2回は twice。

japanese: もう報告書を書き終えましたか？
english: Have you finished the report yet?
alternatives: Have you finished writing the report yet?|Have you finished the report?
explanation: 疑問文の yet =「もう」。

japanese: これは私が昨日買った本です。
english: This is the book I bought yesterday.
alternatives: This is the book that I bought yesterday.|This is the book which I bought yesterday.
explanation: 目的格の関係代名詞（that / which）は省略できる。

japanese: 受付にいる女性に聞いてください。
english: Please ask the woman at the reception desk.
alternatives: Please ask the woman who is at the reception desk.|Please ask the woman at the front desk.|Ask the woman at the reception desk.
explanation: 前置詞句 at 〜 で名詞を後ろから修飾できる。

japanese: 英語を話せるスタッフが必要です。
english: We need staff who can speak English.
alternatives: We need staff that can speak English.|We need someone who can speak English.
explanation: 人を説明する主格の関係代名詞 who。

japanese: 駅の近くにあるホテルに泊まりました。
english: I stayed at a hotel which is near the station.
alternatives: I stayed at a hotel near the station.|I stayed at a hotel that is near the station.
explanation: 物を説明する which / that。

japanese: あなたが探している書類はここにあります。
english: The document you are looking for is here.
alternatives: The document that you are looking for is here.|Here is the document you are looking for.|Here's the document you're looking for.
explanation: 関係代名詞の省略。look for の for を忘れずに。

japanese: これが私の言っていたレストランです。
english: This is the restaurant I told you about.
alternatives: This is the restaurant that I told you about.|This is the restaurant I was talking about.
explanation: tell 人 about 〜 の about が文末に残る。

japanese: 私が欲しいものはこれです。
english: This is what I want.
alternatives: What I want is this.
explanation: what =「〜すること・もの」。

japanese: 彼女が生まれた町は海の近くです。
english: The town where she was born is near the sea.
alternatives: The town she was born in is near the sea.
explanation: 場所を説明する関係副詞 where。

japanese: 窓のそばに立っている男性は私の上司です。
english: The man standing by the window is my boss.
alternatives: The man who is standing by the window is my boss.|The man standing by the window is my supervisor.
explanation: 現在分詞（〜している）で名詞を後ろから修飾。

japanese: これは英語で書かれた手紙です。
english: This is a letter written in English.
alternatives: This is a letter which is written in English.|This is a letter that was written in English.
explanation: 過去分詞（〜された）で名詞を後ろから修飾。

japanese: 修理された自転車を受け取りました。
english: I picked up the repaired bike.
alternatives: I picked up the repaired bicycle.|I got the repaired bike.
explanation: 単独の分詞は名詞の前に置く。

japanese: その知らせはわくわくするものでした。
english: The news was exciting.
explanation: exciting =（人を）わくわくさせる。人が主語なら excited。

japanese: 私はその結果にがっかりしました。
english: I was disappointed with the result.
alternatives: I was disappointed by the result.|I was disappointed at the result.
explanation: disappointed =（人が）がっかりした。

japanese: 修理してもらうために車を預けました。
english: I left my car to have it repaired.
alternatives: I left my car to get it repaired.
explanation: have + 物 + 過去分詞 =「〜してもらう」。

japanese: 髪を切ってもらいました。
english: I had my hair cut.
alternatives: I got my hair cut.|I got a haircut.
explanation: have + 物 + 過去分詞。cut は過去分詞も cut。

japanese: ドアにかぎをかけたままにしておいてください。
english: Please keep the door locked.
alternatives: Keep the door locked.|Please leave the door locked.
explanation: keep + 物 + 過去分詞 =「〜された状態に保つ」。

japanese: 駅がどこにあるか教えていただけますか？
english: Could you tell me where the station is?
alternatives: Can you tell me where the station is?|Could you tell me where the station is located?
explanation: 間接疑問は 疑問詞 + 主語 + 動詞 の語順。

japanese: 会議が何時に始まるか知っていますか？
english: Do you know what time the meeting starts?
alternatives: Do you know when the meeting starts?|Do you know what time the meeting will start?
explanation: Do you know + 間接疑問。

japanese: 彼が来るかどうかわかりません。
english: I don't know if he will come.
alternatives: I don't know whether he will come.|I don't know if he's coming.|I'm not sure if he will come.
explanation: if / whether =「〜かどうか」。

japanese: 忙しかったので行けませんでした。
english: I couldn't go because I was busy.
alternatives: I could not go because I was busy.|I was busy so I couldn't go.
explanation: because + 理由。so を使うと結果を後ろに置く。

japanese: 雨が降っていたけれど試合は行われました。
english: Although it was raining, the game was played.
alternatives: The game was played although it was raining.|Though it was raining, the game was held.|Although it was raining, the game was held.
explanation: although =「〜だけれども」。

japanese: 着いたらすぐに電話してください。
english: Please call me as soon as you arrive.
alternatives: Call me as soon as you arrive.|Please call me as soon as you get there.
explanation: 時を表す節では未来のことも現在形で表す。

japanese: 急がないと電車に乗り遅れますよ。
english: Hurry up, or you'll miss the train.
alternatives: Hurry up or you will miss the train.|If you don't hurry you'll miss the train.|If you don't hurry, you'll miss the train.
explanation: 命令文 + or … =「〜しなさい、さもないと…」。

japanese: 質問があればいつでも聞いてください。
english: If you have any questions, please ask me anytime.
alternatives: Please ask me anytime if you have any questions.|If you have any questions, feel free to ask me.
explanation: if 節 + 命令文。any questions で「何か質問」。

japanese: もし時間があれば手伝うのですが。
english: If I had time, I would help you.
alternatives: If I had time, I'd help you.|I would help you if I had time.|I'd help you if I had time.
explanation: 現在の事実に反する仮定は 過去形 + would。

japanese: もっと英語が上手に話せたらいいのに。
english: I wish I could speak English better.
alternatives: I wish I spoke English better.
explanation: I wish + 過去形 =「〜ならいいのに」。

japanese: 私があなただったらその仕事を引き受けます。
english: If I were you, I would take the job.
alternatives: If I were you, I'd take the job.|I'd take the job if I were you.
explanation: If I were you =「私があなたなら」。助言の定番。

japanese: もっと早く家を出ていれば間に合ったのに。
english: If I had left home earlier, I would have been on time.
alternatives: If I'd left home earlier, I would have been on time.|If I had left earlier, I would have been on time.
explanation: 過去の事実に反する仮定は had + 過去分詞 / would have + 過去分詞。

japanese: 車があればもっと便利なのに。
english: It would be more convenient if I had a car.
alternatives: If I had a car, it would be more convenient.|If I had a car, life would be more convenient.
explanation: 仮定法過去。条件の if 節は後ろにも置ける。

japanese: 窓を開けてもかまいませんか？
english: Would you mind if I opened the window?
alternatives: Do you mind if I open the window?|Would you mind my opening the window?
explanation: Would you mind if I + 過去形? は丁寧な許可の求め方。

japanese: 折り返しお電話いただけますか？
english: Could you call me back?
alternatives: Could you please call me back?|Would you call me back?|Can you call me back?
explanation: call back =「折り返し電話する」。

japanese: 伝言をお願いできますか？
english: Can I leave a message?
alternatives: Could I leave a message?|May I leave a message?
explanation: 電話で不在のときの定番表現。

japanese: ご予約のお名前をいただけますか？
english: May I have your name for the reservation?
alternatives: Could I have your name for the reservation?|Can I have your name for the reservation?
explanation: May I have 〜? =「〜をいただけますか」。

japanese: この用紙に記入していただけますか？
english: Could you fill out this form?
alternatives: Could you please fill out this form?|Would you fill out this form?|Could you fill in this form?
explanation: fill out / fill in =「記入する」。

japanese: タクシーで行くのはどうですか？
english: How about taking a taxi?
alternatives: What about taking a taxi?|Why don't we take a taxi?|Why don't you take a taxi?
explanation: How about 〜ing? =「〜するのはどうですか」。

japanese: 早めに予約することをお勧めします。
english: I recommend making a reservation early.
alternatives: I recommend booking early.|I suggest making a reservation early.|I recommend that you make a reservation early.
explanation: recommend / suggest + 動名詞。

japanese: 少々お待ちいただけますか？
english: Could you hold on a moment?
alternatives: Could you wait a moment?|Could you hold on for a moment?|Please hold on a moment.
explanation: hold on =（電話を切らずに）待つ。

japanese: 会議を来週に延期してもよろしいでしょうか？
english: Would it be possible to postpone the meeting until next week?
alternatives: Can we postpone the meeting until next week?|Could we put off the meeting until next week?|Would it be possible to postpone the meeting to next week?
explanation: Would it be possible to 〜? はとても丁寧な依頼。

japanese: 資料を添付しましたのでご確認ください。
english: I've attached the document so please check it.
alternatives: I have attached the document, so please check it.|Please check the attached document.|I've attached the document. Please check it.
explanation: attach =「添付する」。ビジネスメールの定番。

japanese: ご不便をおかけして申し訳ありません。
english: We apologize for the inconvenience.
alternatives: We are sorry for the inconvenience.|We're sorry for the inconvenience.
explanation: お知らせ・アナウンスで必ず出る表現。

japanese: 電車が到着したとき私はすでに駅にいました。
english: I was already at the station when the train arrived.
alternatives: I had already arrived at the station when the train came.
explanation: 「すでに〜していた」は already を使う。過去のある時点より前のことは過去完了 had + 過去分詞でも表せる。

japanese: 彼女は2時間ずっと待っています。
english: She has been waiting for two hours.
alternatives: She's been waiting for two hours.|She has been waiting for 2 hours.
explanation: 現在完了進行形 have been + 〜ing は動作の継続。

japanese: 来週の今ごろはハワイにいるでしょう。
english: I'll be in Hawaii this time next week.
alternatives: I will be in Hawaii this time next week.|This time next week I'll be in Hawaii.
explanation: this time next week =「来週の今ごろ」。

japanese: 明日の正午までにその仕事を終えているでしょう。
english: I will have finished the work by noon tomorrow.
alternatives: I'll have finished the work by noon tomorrow.|I will have finished the job by noon tomorrow.
explanation: 未来完了 will have + 過去分詞。by =「〜までに」。

japanese: エレベーターは現在点検中です。
english: The elevator is being checked now.
alternatives: The elevator is being inspected now.|The elevator is under inspection now.
explanation: 進行形の受動態 be being + 過去分詞。

japanese: 道路は今工事中です。
english: The road is under construction now.
alternatives: The road is being repaired now.|The road is under construction.
explanation: under construction =「工事中」。お知らせで頻出。

japanese: 彼は来たばかりです。
english: He has just arrived.
alternatives: He's just arrived.|He just arrived.|He has just come.
explanation: just は have と過去分詞の間。

japanese: 会議の前に資料を準備しておきます。
english: I'll prepare the materials before the meeting.
alternatives: I will prepare the materials before the meeting.|I'll get the documents ready before the meeting.
explanation: before + 名詞。materials =「資料」。

category: アナウンス・お知らせ
japanese: 本日は閉店時間が早まります。
english: The store will close early today.
alternatives: The store closes early today.|The shop will close early today.
explanation: アナウンス表現。early は副詞。

category: アナウンス・お知らせ
japanese: 3番線の電車は15分遅れています。
english: The train on track three is fifteen minutes late.
alternatives: The train on platform three is fifteen minutes late.|The train on track 3 is 15 minutes late.|The train on platform 3 is delayed by 15 minutes.|The train on platform three is delayed by fifteen minutes.
explanation: 駅のアナウンスの形。track / platform =「番線」。

category: アナウンス・お知らせ
japanese: お客様は2階の受付にお越しください。
english: Customers should go to the reception desk on the second floor.
alternatives: Customers please go to the reception desk on the second floor.|Please go to the reception desk on the second floor.
explanation: 施設案内でよく出る形。

category: アナウンス・お知らせ
japanese: イベントは雨のため中止になりました。
english: The event was canceled because of rain.
alternatives: The event was cancelled because of rain.|The event was canceled due to rain.|The event was cancelled due to rain.
explanation: because of / due to + 名詞。

category: アナウンス・お知らせ
japanese: 詳しくはウェブサイトをご覧ください。
english: Please visit our website for more information.
alternatives: Please see our website for details.|Please check our website for more information.|For more information please visit our website.
explanation: for more information / for details。

category: アナウンス・お知らせ
japanese: まもなく搭乗を開始します。
english: We will begin boarding soon.
alternatives: We will start boarding soon.|Boarding will begin soon.|We'll begin boarding soon.
explanation: 空港アナウンスの定番。boarding =「搭乗」。

category: アナウンス・お知らせ
japanese: 携帯電話の電源をお切りください。
english: Please turn off your cell phone.
alternatives: Please turn off your mobile phone.|Please turn off your phone.|Please switch off your mobile phone.
explanation: turn off =「（電源を）切る」。

category: アナウンス・お知らせ
japanese: 入場は無料ですが予約が必要です。
english: Admission is free, but a reservation is required.
alternatives: Admission is free, but you need a reservation.|Entry is free, but a reservation is required.
explanation: required =「必要とされる」。お知らせで頻出。
